body.text: Milotic's older evolution method starts with Feebas and its Beauty condition. See the Evolving Feebas into Milotic via Beauty guide for Dry berries, Pokeblocks, Poffins, nature preferences, and reset planning.

links.label: Evolving Feebas into Milotic via Beauty

body.text: To obtain Milotic in many games, you first need to catch Feebas. The Catching Feebas: Every Generation guide hub links to the game-specific Feebas guides before you move on to Beauty or Prism Scale evolution.
